verdict.rationale: Invoicing is a fair axis for a payments platform. The only related evidence is that Adyen offers payment links (adyen-docs-24), which its MCP server can create, get and expire (adyen-supp-mcp-tools); that gives a hosted way to collect an online payment but is not an invoice. Missing for 10: a hosted invoice document or invoicing product, automatic payment reminders or dunning, and any finance-ops invoice workflow evidence.
